descriptionHtml:
思路 / Approach · OAT-01 Signing In & Session Security · S02 「没登录时：只有邮箱验证码能进，错的或用过的验证码被拒，每个路由都有拦截，登录后刷新还在」 Signed out: only email codes get in, a wrong or reused code is refused, every route is gated, and a sign-in survives a reload

覆盖的 UAT 步骤 / 票 AC：

  • U1 Sign-in is by email one-time passcode only: no password field and no shared or static PIN anywhere. The only exception is the two app review accounts, which use a fixed code.（UAT OAT-01 step 1；UAT OAT-01 Expected；TFA-94513 AC 1） — gate: blocked: TFA-94513 in progress
  • U3 After 12 hours idle, the physician has to sign in again with an email OTP.（UAT OAT-01 step 3；UAT OAT-01 Expected；TFA-94513 AC 4） — gate: blocked: TFA-94513 in progress
  • U2 After first login the session credential is kept in the device's secure keychain, and Face ID / fingerprint unlocks the app instead of a full re-login. …（UAT OAT-01 step 2；UAT OAT-01 Expected；TFA-94513 AC 3；TFA-94513 AC 17） — gate: blocked: TFA-94513 in progress

测试设计方法：等价类（equivalence） — 同一条规则换一类输入（医院 / 养老院、另一种数据）再验一次，每一类都要对。

Given A signed-out browser (anonymous project) and DEMO_USER

When Open / and /reset-password?token=old; POST to each password and reset route under /api/auth; enter a wrong 6-digit code; use one valid code twice; open /rounding, /clinic, /snf, /rounding/sheet and /settings directly; sign in through the form, then reload.

Then Both pages show Send sign-in code and no Password field, Forgot or Sign up button. Every password route answers 404. The wrong code shows an alert and no list, and the second use of a code is refused. Every route shows the sign-in gate (the Email field), never the app. After a sign-in, a reload brings the list back without the sign-in screen.

通过的标准（oracle，节选）：auth.anon.spec.ts and login.anon.spec.ts assertions, judged against U1 (no password field anywhere; a code that works twice behaves like a static PIN), U3 (sign-in is actually required on every route, not just the landing page) and the web half of U2 (the session persists after first login; the unlock half is S19 and Q1).

在哪跑：本地 newspec-a（新写的 Playwright）；测试方法 PW · Playwright 脚本；矩阵里排的车道 现成测试（Tim 的 Playwright）（blocked）

S02 是我们自己编的用例号（覆盖矩阵 cases/OAT-01.matrix.json 里的编号），不是 UAT 文档里的步骤号。

环境：本地 — main e02167f，本地栈（local stack, not a deployed build）；run folder runs/2026-10-14-local，lane newspec-a。

测试方法：PW · Playwright 脚本；辅助：API · 接口（Convex 函数） — 按 cases/test-methods.json 的分类，分类说在 both 跑；来源：newspec-a。

Verdict = the Playwright assertions. — Existing deterministic specs; the runner just never selected the anonymous project.

Detail:

Tim's six titles run with --project=anonymous: 6/6 pass (only email codes on / and /reset-password?token=old; all 9 password routes 404; wrong code refused with an alert; a code works once; /rounding /clinic /snf /rounding/sheet /settings gated; sign-in survives a reload). These use DEMO_USER (existing tests, not new). Collision risk: these titles sign in and issue codes for the shared DEMO_USER (the matrix requires it); a parallel job using DEMO_USER can invalidate their codes, so run S02 when no other job uses that account.
